title: Esses fixture description (fixture-1)
description: fixture.json of one fixture directory fixtures/<formatId>/<name>/ or fixtures/private/<formatId>/<name>/ (05 section 9.1, D-033, D-127): the input and its companions with their hashes, provenance and licence, the reader options, the dialect the probe must report and the oracle the expected channel values come from. Closed: a misspelt member is an error. Policy rules encoded here: a public fixture (private false) needs a redistributable licence; a vendor-software export oracle needs private true and a recorded permission (05 section 9.1). Semantic rules the schema cannot express (a self oracle never settles a dialect claim, D-041) are checked by fixture verify.

$schema.description: Schema id (D-072). The urn:esses: form is written; the bare esses: form of earlier drafts and the later https form are accepted on load and normalised on save (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

schemaVersion.description: Minor version within major 1 (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

format.description: The importer id whose file stem names the corpus directory ("motec.ld").

companions.description: Companions sit beside the input with the same stem (input.ldx), because companion discovery is by sibling stem.

source.description: Provenance prose: who produced the input, with what, when.

provenance.description: Provenance class of the input (CLEANROOM.md categories, D-145): synthetic (written by Esses' own generator, esses-gen-fixtures), user-device-log (the user's own logger files), user-tool-output (outputs of the user's own tools), third-party (another producer's export, licence per D-040) or vendor-sample (vendor sample and test-model files, D-117, D-146). Absent: not stated.

licence.description: SPDX licence expression of the input ("CC0-1.0", "LicenseRef-unknown").

permission.description: Why the file may be used here (the U-03/U-13 answer for private fixtures).

private.description: true: lives in fixtures/private (never committed to the public tree, D-005).

dialect.description: The dialect string the probe must report (probe-1 dialect).

channelsCompared.description: "all" (default) or the logged names whose expected.channels/<channel>.csv.gz files exist.

allOf.description: A public fixture needs a licence that permits redistribution (D-040, D-127).
A private fixture records why it may be used.
A vendor-software export oracle needs a private fixture and a recorded permission (05 section 9.1).

remote.description: For inputs over 2 MB that are not committed: where CI fetches and caches them; null or absent otherwise.

inputFileName.description: input.<ext>: the input and its companions share the stem "input".

importOptions.description: ImportOptions.options: reader options keyed by importer namespace, validated in full against the importer's options schema. The .ld reader's ld.shiftOrder is checked here (D-037: default afterMul).

oracle.description: Where the expected channel values come from (05 section 9.1, D-041). Kinds: ref-decode (tools/ld_ref_decode.py), public-project (a pinned third-party decoder), converter, self (round trips of our own writer only), and the vendor-software export kind of 05 section 9.1, matched by exportOracleKind.

ref.description: The oracle tool or project with its version and licence.

permitted.description: The recorded permission to use this oracle (U-03/U-13).

validity.description: What the valid column of expected.channels/*.csv asserts. strict (default): it is the expected validity of every listed sample (the generator's declared invalid ranges for synthetic families). finite-only: the oracle reports only non-finite values as invalid (tools/ld_ref_decode.py does not decode gap blocks), so a sample the reader marks invalid while the oracle has a finite value is counted, not compared.

tolerance.description: Per-dtype comparison tolerance; integers and timestamps are always exact (AC-M0-02).

exportOracleKind.description: The vendor-software export oracle kind of 05 section 9.1 (<product>-export). It is matched by pattern because the vendor-mark lint (D-125) allows no product name in schemas/.

dialect.description: Comma-separated dialect flags in the importer's documented order, no spaces ("m1,pro-logging"); "" when none applies (05 section 3.8).

legacyBag.description: Fields removed by a migration, kept verbatim (02 section 6.6 rule 3).
